<script>
(function(){
const root=document.getElementById('p90plus'), modal=document.getElementById('p90modal');
root.querySelectorAll('.card').forEach(card=>card.addEventListener('click',()=>{
document.getElementById('p90modalimg').src=card.dataset.img;
document.getElementById('p90modalname').textContent=card.dataset.name;
document.getElementById('p90modalprice').textContent=card.dataset.price;
modal.classList.add('open');
}));
document.getElementById('p90close').onclick=()=>modal.classList.remove('open');
modal.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===modal)modal.classList.remove('open')});
root.querySelectorAll('.size').forEach(s=>s.addEventListener('click',()=>{root.querySelectorAll('.size').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));s.classList.add('active')}));
document.getElementById('p90add').onclick=()=>{let n=+document.getElementById('p90cart').textContent||0;document.getElementById('p90cart').textContent=n+1;alert('Товар добавлен в корзину');modal.classList.remove('open')});
})();
